_note: `cmd` is the base argv the runner appends `<conformance|run|closure-probe> --runtime ... ` to.
The runner also discovers `<adapter_dir>/adapter.json` with a `cmd` list, a package
(`a0_adapter`/`adapter` with __main__.py, cli.py or main.py) under `<adapter_dir>` or
executable in `<adapter_dir>/bin/`. An empty registry changes nothing: it is only needed
when none of those layouts match.
